method: Inspected Google review panels locally. Reviewed 41 candidate photos across general, matcha and dessert review searches. Selected images are attached to the corresponding review; no unrelated brand photos. English text is an editorial translation of the labelled excerpt. Full Arabic originals and photo attribution remain available. Images resized/WebP encoded only; display cropping uses CSS object-position.
